active: I'm on the line. Eyes up, call it as I see it.
Course is clean. Mostly. Listen for me.
You fly, I talk. That's the deal.

active.text: I've got your back the whole way, {you}.
Big breath. You know this course better than you think.
Fly your line. I'll do the worrying.

injured: Arm's in a sling, but my mouth works fine.
I'll call it from the chair today. Fly kind.

injured.text: Sling's on, voice is fine. Let's have a good one, {you}.
I'll be sitting down, but I'm still cheering.
Fly like I'm watching. I am, from the comfy chair.

active.text: I'll be on the line the whole way. Take it.
Nice one. I can see the whole course from my spot.
Fly this and I'll talk you through every turn.
This one's got your name on it, {you}.
I'll spot, you shine. Deal?
Say yes. I already packed snacks.

injured.text: Arm's in a sling, but I can still call it. Take it.
I'll spot from the chair. Just say yes.
Ribs hurt. Eyes work. Let's go.
I can spot this one from a stool. Let's go, {you}.
Sore arm, sharp eyes. Take it.
I'll talk you round it. Gently, for both our sakes.

active: Gate. Good line.
Through. Next one's left.
Clean. Keep the speed.
Nice. Tighter on the next.
That's how it's done.
Gate. Don't get cocky.

active.text: Beautiful. Do that again.
Ha! Threaded it, {you}.
Look at you go.

injured: Gate. Ow. Good line.
Through. I felt that one in my ribs.
Clean. Keep it clean.

injured.text: Gate. That made the arm feel better.
Lovely line, {you}.
Through. I'm smiling under the sling.

active: Hey! I'm right here!
Watch it, I'm standing in that!
Pull up, pull up!
Stop. I'm in your path. Ease off now.
Please pull wide. I'm right below you.
I'm here, on the line. Give me room.
injured: Not again, please, not again!
I can't dodge with this leg. Back off!
Please, give me room. I can't move quickly.
I'm still hurt. Pull away from me, please.
Ease off. I need you to fly wide of me.

active: Agh! That's my shoulder!
Okay. Okay. I'm down.
Medic. Somebody. Please.
I'm hit. Stay calm. Get someone to me.
I'm down. It's okay. Just stop the drone.
That hurt. I need help over here.
injured: I told you. I told you.
That's... not good. That's not good.
I'm hit again. I need help, right now.
Stay with me. Someone get a medic.
I can't get up this time. Please hurry.

active: That's a finish. Nice flying.
Done. Buy me a drink.
I barely had to talk. Good.

active.text: That's my pilot! Beautiful run, {you}.
Clean finish. I'm telling everyone.
You made that look easy. I know it wasn't.

injured: Done. My ribs thank you.
Finished. Quietly. Nicely done.

injured.text: Finished! Best thing I've seen all week, {you}.
Done. That cheered me right up.
Lovely flying. Worth every wince.

active: Shake it off. We go again.
Not your day. Happens.
Listen to me next time, yeah?

active.text: Hey. One bad run doesn't make you a bad pilot.
Shake it off, {you}. I still like your odds.
You were close. Next one's ours.

injured: We'll get it. Slower, maybe.
Not today. I'm too sore to be mad.

injured.text: It's alright. We're both having a day.
Chin up, {you}. I'll be right here for the next one.
Slower and steadier. You've got this.

active: Numbers don't lie. Mostly.
Fair grade. I'd argue the timing.
Look at those splits.

active.text: I'd frame that grade. Maybe.
See that? That's you getting better, {you}.
Every run, a bit sharper. I notice.

injured: Grade's fine. My arm is not.
We'll do better when I can stand.

injured.text: Good grade. Better than my week, {you}.
Proud of that one. Arm and all.
I'll read the splits twice. Doctor says rest.

active: Couple of weeks in a sling. I'll still talk your ear off.
Benched. Somebody else can stand by the gate for a while.
I'll live. Fly kinder next time.
I'll heal. Don't carry this alone. We'll talk it through.
A few weeks off. I'll still be on the radio when I can.
It hurts, but I'm here. Fly careful while I mend.

memorial: Marlo, spotter. Called every gate, even the last one.

active: Copy. Moving.
Marked. On my way.
Seen it. Going.

active.text: On it, {you}. Leave it to me.
Copy. Happy to.
Moving. I'll call it when I'm there.

active: Down the shaft. Slow. Slower than that.
Floor's under you. Turn left and follow it round.
Long left curve. Keep off the top, it's low.
Steady. Middle of the channel.
Still curving left. Don't chase it, let it come.
Walls are close here. Small corrections.
Halfway. You're doing fine. Breathe.
Keep the curve. Nothing sudden.
Nearly there. Easy on the speed.
Shutter's ahead, on the floor. Ease off.
There. Drop through the shutter. Gently.
Good flying. I mean it. Every call, you took it clean.

active.text: You're up. I've got eyes on you.
Liftoff. Talk to me if it feels wrong.
Up and clean. Now keep it that way.
And up! Lovely, {you}.
Clean lift. Let's have a good one.
You're flying. I'm watching. Perfect.

injured.text: You're up. I'm watching from the chair.
Liftoff. Easy on my nerves today.
Up and away. You cheer me up, {you}.
Liftoff. I'm with you, chair and all.
Lovely and smooth. Keep it gentle for me.

active.text: Close! Too close!
That was a hand's width. Breathe.
You shaved paint off that one.
Whoa! Okay, you're fine. Breathe, {you}.
Close one. You've got it, just ease off.
Eep! Still in one piece? Good.

injured.text: Don't do that to me. Not today.
Close! My ribs just flinched.
Yikes! You okay? I flinched for both of us.
Easy now, {you}. Plenty of room if you take it.
Close. Deep breath. I believe in you.

active.text: Low pass, nice. Watch the lip.
You're kissing the ground. Pull a hair.
Under the radar. Pretty line.
Ooh, low and pretty. Nice, {you}.
Skimming the deck! Love it.
Low and steady. That's control.

injured.text: Low and quick. I'd cheer if it didn't hurt.
That's low. Careful with it.
Low pass! I'd clap if I could.
Low and careful. That's my pilot.
Pretty line, {you}. Easy up after.

active.text: You're flat out. Eyes way ahead.
That's top end. Pick your exit now.
Fast. Good. Now think.
Zoom! Look at you go, {you}.
Flat out and still tidy. Show-off.
That's fast. That's fun. Mind the corner.

injured.text: Fast. Too fast for my heart today.
Top end. Pick your exit early.
Wow, quick! Careful, but wow.
Speedy. Take it easy on the turns, {you}.
Fast and clean. Made my day.

active.text: Battery's low. Start heading home.
Quarter charge. Don't get greedy.
You're on reserve. Land it soon.
Pack's getting tired, {you}. Bring it home.
Low battery. You've got time, just head back.
Charge is low. Easy landing, no rush.

injured.text: Battery's low. Bring it home gentle.
Reserve. Don't make me watch a dead stick.
Battery's low. Gentle trip home, okay?
Running low, {you}. Plenty of time to land.
Low pack. Let's both rest soon.

active.text: Ooh. That one hurt to watch.
Contact! You okay up there?
And that's a wall. Shake it off.
Ouch! You okay, {you}? Happens to the best.
Bonk. We'll laugh about that later.
Big crash, small deal. Up you get.

injured.text: That sound. I know that sound.
Contact. Join the club.
Ow. Now we match, {you}.
Crunch. You're fine. Drone's fixable.
Shake it off. I'm shaking mine off too.

active.text: Reset. Clean slate, same line.
Back on the pad. Go again.
Fresh air under you. Try it slower.
Fresh start. You've got this, {you}.
Back on the pad. Second go's the charm.
Reset. Breathe out, then fly.

injured.text: Reset. Take a breath. I am.
Back to the start. Steady.
Again! I'm in no rush, {you}.
Clean slate. I'll call it nice and clear.
Reset. One easy gate at a time.

active.text: Weather's moving. Feel the air change.
Sky's turning. Adjust your lines.
New weather. Everything's a bit harder now.
Weather's turning. You'll handle it, {you}.
New sky. Same great pilot.
Air's changed. Fly it soft and you'll be fine.

injured.text: Weather's turning. My knee called it.
Sky's changing. Fly it careful.
Weather's moving. Steady hands, {you}.
Sky's changing. We'll ride it out together.
New weather. Nothing you can't fly.

active.text: You going to fly, or admire the view?
Nice hold. Now do something with it.
Still waiting on you, pilot.
Enjoying the view, {you}? Fair enough.
Take your time. I'll be here.
Nice still hover. Very calm.

injured.text: Taking a breather? Fair. Me too.
Nice hold. I'm in no hurry today.
Hovering with me? Good company, {you}.
No rush. I'm not going anywhere either.
Steady as a rock. Love it.

active.text: Marlo here. No course today, just sky. Go play.
I'm on the radio. Fly anywhere, I'll keep you company.
Free flight, huh? I'll spot for fun.
Marlo here! Fly anywhere, {you}. I'll tag along.
Day off? Best kind. Show me something fun.
Sky's all yours. I'll cheer from down here.

injured.text: Marlo, from the couch. Fly something pretty for me.
Still on the mend. I can still talk, though. Go.
Hey, {you}. Fly me something pretty.
Marlo, resting up. Glad to hear your props.
I'm on the couch with the radio. Let's have fun.

active.text: There it is. Nice find.
Made it. Clean.
Good. That's the spot.
You found it! Nice one, {you}.
Right on the spot. Lovely.
Made it! Where to next?

injured.text: Made it. Nice and easy.
There. Good flying.
There! That cheered me up, {you}.
Spot on. Nicely flown.
You made it. I knew you would.

active.text: Hey, {you}. Board's warm, coffee's not.
There's my pilot. Pick something fun.
Back already? Good. I was getting bored.

injured.text: Hey, {you}. I'm on the radio from the couch.
Good to see you. Pick a gentle one.
Still here. Still watching gates for you.

active.text: That's a streak, {you}! Keep threading them.
Gate, gate, gate. I'm running out of ways to say nice.
Clean line through all of those. Don't look down now.

injured.text: Clean run, {you}. Best thing I've seen all week.
All of them, clean. Keep it smooth.
That's a streak. I'm smiling from the bench.

active.text: Run it back, {you}. You know the line now.
Same course, better pilot. Go.
Shake it off. I'll call every gate.

injured.text: Again. I'll talk you through it, {you}.
Second try's the good one. Easy.
You've got it this time. I can tell.

active.text: Something new! Look at you, {you}.
Shiny. Don't let it go to your head on my gates.
That's a big step. Nice one.

injured.text: Something new. Show me later, {you}.
Look at that. Good for you.
New stuff. I'll watch from here.

active.text: Go rest your thumbs, {you}. See you soon.
Signing off. Same gates tomorrow.
Bye, champ. Fly in your dreams.

injured.text: See you, {you}. I'll keep the radio on.
Bye. Rest up. Both of us.
Signing off. Come back soon.
